description: Manages the configuration and metadata of various entities and their fields within the system, defining their structure, properties, and how they are displayed.

endpoints.name: GetEntities
endpoints.description: Get all available entities for dropdown selection.
example_uses: How can I get a list of all entities available in the system?
Show me the entities that can be selected in a dropdown.
I need to retrieve the names of all configurable entities.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a simple list of all entity names, typically for populating dropdowns or selection lists in a user interface.

endpoints.name: GetEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Get entity configuration details by entity name for the frontend screen.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to retrieve configuration for.

example_uses: Retrieve the configuration details for the 'Partner' entity.
What are the settings for the 'Project' entity?
Get the full configuration object for a specific entity like 'Contact'.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch the detailed configuration, including fields and properties, for a specific entity by its name, typically for displaying on a configuration screen.

endpoints.name: SaveEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Save entity configuration (entity description and field configurations).

entityName.description: The name of the entity whose configuration is being saved.

request.description: The request body containing the entity's description and field configurations.

example_uses: Update the configuration for the 'Project' entity.
Save new field definitions for the 'Task' entity.
I want to persist changes made to an entity's configuration.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to update or save the entire configuration of an existing entity, including its description and the definitions of its fields.

endpoints.name: GetAllEntityConfigurations
endpoints.description: Get all entity configurations (for admin purposes).
example_uses: List all configured entities and their details.
Show me a complete overview of all entity configurations in the system.
I need to retrieve all entity configurations for administrative review.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a comprehensive list of all configured entities and their full configurations, typically for administrative dashboards or overview screens.

endpoints.name: CreateEntityConfiguration

request.description: The request body containing details for the new entity configuration.

example_uses: Create a new entity called 'Milestone'.
Define a new configurable entity in the system.
I need to add a new entity configuration.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to define and create a brand new entity configuration within the system.

endpoints.name: UpdateEntityConfiguration

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity configuration to update.

request.description: The request body containing the updated entity configuration details.

example_uses: Update the configuration for the entity with ID 123.
Modify an existing entity's configuration by its ID.
I want to change the settings for a specific entity configuration.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify an existing entity configuration by its unique identifier.

endpoints.name: DeleteEntityConfiguration

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity configuration to delete.

example_uses: Delete the entity configuration with ID 456.
Remove an entity configuration from the system.
I need to delete a specific entity configuration.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to permanently remove an entity configuration from the system using its unique identifier.

endpoints.name: GetEntityFields
endpoints.description: Get fields for a specific entity configuration.

entityManagerId.description: The unique identifier of the entity configuration to retrieve fields for.

example_uses: List all fields defined for the entity configuration with ID 789.
Show me the field definitions for a particular entity.
I need to get the fields associated with an entity configuration.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve all the field definitions (e.g., name, type, properties) associated with a specific entity configuration, identified by its ID.

endpoints.name: CreateEntityField

request.description: The request body containing details for the new entity field.

example_uses: Add a new field to an entity.
Define a new custom field for an entity configuration.
I want to create a new field for an entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to define and create a new field that can be associated with an entity configuration.

endpoints.name: UpdateEntityField

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity field to update.

request.description: The request body containing the updated entity field details.

example_uses: Update the field with ID 101.
Modify an existing entity field's properties.
I need to change the definition of a specific field.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to modify an existing entity field's definition by its unique identifier.

endpoints.name: DeleteEntityField

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity field to delete.

example_uses: Delete the field with ID 202.
Remove an entity field from the system.
I need to delete a specific field definition.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to permanently remove an entity field definition from the system using its unique identifier.

endpoints.name: GetRelatedEntityFields
endpoints.description: Get available fields for a related entity type (for relationship field configuration).

entityType.description: The type of the related entity to retrieve fields for.

example_uses: What fields are available for a related 'Project' entity?
Show me the fields I can link to from a 'Contact' entity.
I need to see the fields of a related entity for configuring a relationship.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of fields from a specified related entity type, which is useful when configuring relationship fields between entities.

endpoints.name: GetFieldOptionsForDataType
endpoints.description: Get field options for a specific data type in the context of an entity.

dataType.description: The data type for which to retrieve field options.

contextEntityName.description: The name of the entity providing context for the field options.

example_uses: What are the available options for a 'string' field within the 'User' entity context?
Show me the field options for a 'boolean' data type in the 'Task' entity.
I need to get the specific options for a field based on its data type and the entity it belongs to.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve specific configuration options or enumerations relevant to a field of a given data type, considering the context of the entity it belongs to.

endpoints.name: GetEntityListViewConfiguration
endpoints.description: Get list view configuration for an entity (for dynamic column generation).

entityName.description: The name of the entity to retrieve list view configuration for.

example_uses: What are the default columns for the 'Partner' entity's list view?
Show me how the 'Project' entity's list view is configured.
I need the list view settings for a specific entity to generate dynamic columns.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve the configuration that defines how an entity's data should be displayed in a list view, including which fields should be shown as columns.
